import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (standard combined log format):
    IP - - [DD/Mon/YYYY:HH:MM:SS +0000] "METHOD URL HTTP/VERSION" STATUS BYTES "REFERER" "USER_AGENT"

    Returns a dict with keys:
        ip, timestamp, method, url, http_version, status, bytes, referer, user_agent
    """
    # Regex to capture the standard combined log format fields
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?P<ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+) '
        r'- - '
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\] '
        r'"(?P<method>[A-Z]+) '
        r'(?P<url>[^\s]+) '
        r'(?P<http_version>HTTP/\d+\.\d+)" '
        r'(?P<status>\d{3}) '
        r'(?P<bytes>\d+|-) '
        r'"(?P<referer>[^\"]*)" '
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^\"]*)"'
    )

    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        return {}

    return match.groupdict()
